de'longhi - truebrew automatic single se.description: TrueBrew is an innovative, automatic coffee machine that brews drip coffee from fresh, whole coffee beans —all at the touch of a button. TrueBrew is built to suit all of your coffee needs, for consistent, freshly ground coffee, every time. Simply pour in your favorite beans, make your selection, and press “Brew.” Then, TrueBrew takes care of the rest. De’Longhi’s proprietary Bean Extract Technology automatically grinds, doses and brews to capture the coffee’s full flavor and aroma and then crafts the perfect cup for you. You can personalize to your needs with 6 sizes (3, 8, 12, 16, 20, or 24oz cups) and 5 brew styles (Light, Gold, Bold, Espresso-Style or Over-Ice). The Over-Ice style automatically adjusts the dose and brew to create a refreshingly bold & balanced iced coffee. TrueBrew uses whole beans not plastic pods or filters, creating zero waste. Plus, with a Built-In Clock and Auto-On function, you can schedule your perfect cup of coffee to be ready exactly when you want it. TrueBrew combines our most precise and adaptive brewing technology with true one-touch simplicity, bringing you the purest taste possible, exactly how you like it, and all at the press of a button. TrueBrew transforms your at-home coffee experience.

until dawn 2 - playstation 5.name: Until Dawn 2 - PlayStation 5
until dawn 2 - playstation 5.description: A team of secretly sceptical ghost hunters lands a TV deal after one of their social media stunts goes viral. Their new gig takes them to an abandoned resort on a remote desert island, where a woman’s chilling story of demons and ghostly phenomena promises a killer television debut. Strange events begin to unfold, and intrigue turns to alarm as a ghostly boy and his vengeful mother drag the team into a nightmarish survival scenario where they may actually die for likes. From Firesprite, every relationship, conversation and split-second decision shapes who lives and who dies before sunrise. EVERYONE CAN LIVE. EVERYONE CAN DIE: Guide a cast of playable characters through a branching night of terror where every decision carries visible consequences. Shape relationships, trust and survival through dialogue choices and split-second reactions. Think fast and expect the unexpected as your story heads towards one of several thrilling endings. Replay to take different twists and turns and uncover completely different outcomes. MODERN SUPERNATURAL HORROR: Step into a mystery rooted in guilt, folklore and escalating dread rather than cheap jump scares. Contrast the island’s tropical beauty with the horror hidden beneath its surface. Search rich shadows for clues and study intricate settings ripe with environmental storytelling. Uncover a tragedy born of heartbreak and sorrow, and the vengeance it left behind. MEET YOUR STREAM TEAM: Meet a cast of fame seekers and social stars brought to life by a star-studded crew of performers. Watch friendships fracture as ambition, fear and blame spread through the group. Analyse minute facial expressions in conversations rendered in incredible detail on PS5. Grab a friend and share the scares by passing the controller to solve puzzles and dodge death together.
